correctness.rationale: For any functional the b_i columns of the vertex-edge Kirillov block are supported only in the hub row, giving rank D<=m+1. A general alternating-matrix rank bound, including even rank in characteristic two, gives rank at most 2(m+1)+2floor(m/2). The exhibited coefficient functional has D-rank m+1 and has floor(m/2) nondegenerate planes on ker D^T. Hence it attains the global bound for every field. The independent graph-bracket checker matches the claimed value in 40 finite-field cases and exhaustive binary cases m<=3.
